title: AI, Security, and Geopolitical Risks Drive the Next Wave of Cloud and SaaS Structural Changes (Mar 2026)
core_insight: AI‑driven services and heightened security are reshaping cloud infrastructure, while geopolitical AI‑hardware constraints and strategic M&A signal deeper structural shifts across the industry.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS adds S3 Tables, S3 Vectors and S3 Metadata; Google Cloud launches Identity Aware Proxy for Cloud Run; Azure introduces Budget Bytes for low‑cost AI apps. AWS releases EC2 Hpc8a instances with 5th‑gen AMD EPYC processors; Google Cloud acquires Wiz to strengthen AI‑era security; Microsoft Azure unveils GPT‑5.4 in Foundry; Azure adds instant‑access incremental snapshots; Cloudflare rolls out AI Security for Apps.
